E0117

This map repeats a key

What

This map repeats a key

Why

A key can appear only once in a map literal or pattern

Fix

Remove the repeated key.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0117: tests/ui/pattern_ratified_map_alias_duplicate.stderr.

Error [E0117]: Key text:name appears twice in this map pattern
  --> pattern_ratified_map_alias_duplicate.jet:6:29
    |
  6 |   if values == [KEY: first, ALIAS: second] -> print(first)
    |                             ^^^^^
 Why: Each key of a map pattern is looked up once
 Fix: Remove the repeated entry, or merge its pattern into the first one
